messages.subject: help on creating CDF files
parts:
Hi.

I'm wondering if there is a nice description of how to make a CDF file
from scratch. Specifically, I'm interested in creating a CDF file
that can be used with 'ExonRmaPlm' ... I believe this requires groups
(of probes for exons) within groups (of exons for transcripts). I'm
in the middle of reverse engineering some of Ken's code that he used
to make the HuEx....,core.cdf file, but I'm wondering if there is a
facility to do this.

Maybe the easiest way is to create the nested lists by hand?

Thanks,
Mark

I haven't created a custom CDF myself. There is no special
class/method in aroma.affymetrix for doing this. You have to use the
methods in affxparser. If you have enough of memory you could create
the nested CDF list in memory and use writeCdf() to write it out. I
guess Ken started of with readCdfUnits() and manipulated the nested
list from that.

Feel free to add notes to the group page as you go.

Cheers
